verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents per-issue counts of affected users or sessions, or any impact-based prioritization. The items it does contain cover issue states, ownership rules, Session Replay (title only) and agent conversation replay, none of which quantify an issue's blast radius. Impact analytics is a fair axis for an error-monitoring platform, so the absence of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As an SRE, every issue quantifies real impact — how many users and sessions are affected — so I prioritize by blast radius, not raw event counts
